reviews.x: Of all the mascara I have tried through the years, I truly like this the best. It stays waterproof but it isn't like you need to scrub your face raw to remove it with a little cleanser either. It is also doesn't clump. I laugh and call it the unicorn tube in my makeup bag, since the packaging is a bit loud.
**UPDATE** love the product!! Bold color to give your eyes the perfect pop! Got a free makeup brush set as well!! Love the product!Doesn’t flake or raccoon eyes!!I love looking at the bottle!

My new favorite liquid eyeliner and mascara 😍 The liquid eye liner works so well for the price! Not only does it look amazing it works amazing.
I am happy with this product so far. I will purchase again if it holds up.

The packaging and the product  is presented very nicely.  I also received a free gift with my purchase which I had a choice of 3.  Customer service was exceptional and sent my gift right away.

reviews.t: Save your money and buy a 5$tube of Essance mascara
reviews.x: Packaging is cute. Product is thick and stringy and in no way lengthens my eyelashes. Wiping the wand is no help either and if you try to build it up in thin layers then they just become spider lashes on the third swipe.  Not easy to remove.

Did not receive the eye liner.  It wasnt in the box.  I have used the mascara twice an REALLY like it. It doesnt make my top lashes look any longer but it does give sum length to the lower lashes.  It doesn't CLUMP!  MAJOR PLUS!

reviews.x: This is truly an amazing product for the price! I was shopping for an eyeliner and waterproof mascara for the first time in years. I ran across these and was immediately attracted to the beautiful, unicorn 🦄 packaging. I know, I know. Pretty packaging doesn’t mean a quality product. But in this case, it does!  Omg! The eyeliner is amazing!!! I’m not good at drawing a cat eye (or taking makeup selfies, obviously), but this glides on very easily! You can easily make a very thin line (which I like

reviews.t: Beautiful packaging, luxurious texture, but not waterproof.
reviews.x: I have to say, this is a beautiful product and very luxurious in packaging and texture. I loved the creamy mascara and this mascara made my lashes look long and full. However, this product is NOT waterproof. The mascara ran as soon as water touched my eyelashes and the liquid eyeliner cracks and runs pretty quickly. If this product were truly waterproof, it would be the perfect product for me. I will be returning.

The packaging is so beautiful..definitely the most beautiful mascara tube I own... however.. this does not even come CLOSE to what they advertise. I added about 5 coats to my lashes. I noticed 0 difference in length and it doesnt thicken at all. I even added my own mascara and added this to the top to see if it would  lengthen as advertised. It did not. Very dissapointed.

reviews.t: The effect is very good, the eyes are very divine
reviews.x: The appearance and quality are OK. The color is beautiful. I didn't expect the effect to be so good. There is no halo and dark circles around the eyes. The eyelashes are well rooted. You don't have to worry about caking. It's better than you bought before. It's much easier to use than the other brands you bought before. I like it so much. It's recommended to buy it

reviews.t: Not as good as I expected
reviews.x: The mascara seemed a bit thick and was not easy to put on. It clumped a lot. It stayed on and I had no problems taking it off with makeup remover. Overall it was just ok. I tried it several days with the same results.  It didn’t lengthen my lashes like it said it would. I probably will just stick with my Lancôme mascara.

reviews.t: Eyeliner goes dry way too fast, only used it twice.
reviews.x: i loved the presentation of the eyeliner and mascara and the package. But, i only used my eyeliner maybe once or twice and it went completely dry, i tried some things to make it liquidy again, and its still dry. My mascara is wayyy to clumpy. Just not a good product to buy.

This item is not waterproof.  It also does not make your eye lashes bigger or longer.  The liner does not go on smooth. But skips spaces and is not waterproof and disappears within an hour.  Do not recommend wasting your money purchasing these items.

reviews.t: Mixed review: Great eyeliner; terrible mascara
reviews.x: Really like the eyeliner. It’s dark and stays well, lasting for hours. The mascara is black but doesn’t coat eyelashes so since they are sold together it’s a three star. Alone, the eyeliner would get five stars and the mascara one .

This is the best mascara I’ve ever used. All my life I’ve had smudges on my brow area from my mascara touching my oily skin, but this mascara doesn’t do this and my lashes look AMAZING. I’ve never loved a mascara more than this one.

I was suckered by the good reviews. This was not any better than generic drugstore mascara. I coated. I did the zig zag. I have better mascara in my bag that cost less. The only saving grace is the container is beautiful.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the mascara and eyeliner, calling them the best they've tried and saying they stay on all day.
Several reviewers praise the long-wearing, smudge-proof, non-clumping formula that doesn't flake or give raccoon eyes.
A notable number of reviewers complain the mascara is thick, goopy, stringy, sticky, or clumps lashes together.
Some reviewers report receiving incomplete or defective orders, such as a missing eyeliner or a dried-out liner.
A few reviewers mention the cute packaging and free gifts as positives.
